Package com.saicone.types

package com.saicone.types
This package provides the common type-related classes that are used across the project.

The primary class is TypeParser which is used to provide a conversion between objects, next to Types being the library itself by providing a TypeParser storage and registration, while TypeOf is a lazy conversion provider that uses registered type parsers.

For iteration, the AnyIterable can be used by encapsulating values like iterables, maps, arrays or single objects.

There are high-level interactions using AnyObject that provides easy-to-use methods to convert a delegated value, while TypeWrapper is a more complex conversion which is focused on lazy values without convert a whole data structure.
